message.content:
This is a phone case, which is classified as an accessory. Fitted cell phone cases of plastic fall under 4202.99 or 3926.90. Heading 4202 covers "similar containers," and the subheading for other materials is 4202.99.90. Cases of plastic sheeting are classified at 4202.92 only when they are shaped or fitted containers. CBP has often classified fitted phone cases under 4202.32 (plastic sheeting outer surface) or 4202.99.90, and for molded hard plastic cases CBP has used 3926.90.99.

Here the case is a two-part fitted case of G10 composite (fiberglass-reinforced epoxy) with metal bezels, which is not plastic sheeting or leather. Heading 4202.99 covers "other" containers, and its 4202.99.90 subheading is the general "other" provision. Hard molded cases not specially shaped for sale as containers have been classed in 3926.90.99. However, a case specially shaped and fitted to hold a phone is covered by 4202 as a "case" (the heading names "cases... and similar containers"). Under the 4202.99 breakdown, 4202.99.90 is the "other" provision at the 10-digit level: 4202.99.9000.

Because the four styles share a rear housing of G10 and differ only in bezel, one code must cover them. The G10 composite rear housing gives the essential character, and the metal bezel does not change that. The 4202.99.90 classification therefore fits all four.
